node.statement: Existence and uniqueness by the exact external lem-stage1-quantitative-inverse-function. Fix P and apply that lemma to h↦F(P,h) on B^{calH}_{2delta}(0), with the Banach-space isomorphism I_calH, center 0, radius 2delta, and derivative constant c=64s. Node 1.2 gives ||D_HF-I||<=c<1, so the map is injective and its image contains F(P,0)+B^{calH}_{2delta(1-c)}(0). Also node 1.2.1 and ||q||<=2delta give ||F(P,0)||<=delta+64(e delta+delta^2)=delta(1+c)<2delta(1-c), since c<=1/8. Hence 0 belongs to that image and determines a unique g_V(P) in the stated open ball.
